title: Story Completion
description: Play through the entire campaign, clearing every main story beat and chapter. Story trophies unlock automatically as you finish missions, so the only requirement is following the plot to its end. No grinding or side content is needed here — just push the story forward and enjoy it. The final mission trophy lands with the credits.

title: Collectibles & World
description: Sweep the state of Leonida once the story has opened up the whole map. Knock out the collectible and exploration trophies by travelling region by region. Meditate at every spot, complete card sets, trigger every WAiNK location, discover vehicles, walk into all 52 areas, buy the garages and register rides. Doing these in one organised tour beats backtracking later.

title: Strangers & Side Content
description: Turn aside from the main path to help the locals and clear the stranger mission strands. Finish each named stranger's arc to its final mission for its closing trophy, win the fishing challenge and complete an arcade game. These vanish as the story advances, so clear them while the characters are still available. Pick up any you miss during the run and come back before the credits if you want the full set.

title: Activities, Online & Shared Economy
description: Grind the activity and challenge trophies alongside normal play rather than forcing them at the end. Pull stunts, try every activity type, gold the shooting ranges, win drone races and races, and complete challenges. Then handle the shared-economy trophies — making choices, laundering money and spending across shops — which build up naturally through the online and single-player economy. There is no dedicated multiplayer trophy list in this build; the GTA VI online model is folded into the shared economy above.

title: Crime, Combat Cleanup & Missables
description: Clean up the crime and combat trophies, and — most importantly — grab every missable moment before it slips away. Do the missable ones early and carefully: lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob three shops back-to-back, force an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, the bowling visit, the partnership breakthrough, the second-chance encounter and the weird 'what the hell' event. Then keep the counts ticking over: Combat Focus takedowns, the tank fight, a stealth jewelry heist, five bank vaults, an armored truck, all nine gang operations, the melee drive-by and the rest.

title: Platinum Run
description: With everything else done, finish the clean-up run for 100% completion, confirm no trophy was missed, and then the platinum unlocks the moment the rest of the list is complete. Save it for the very end — there is nothing special to do beyond holding every other trophy.
